review.full:
Submission recorded (verified): Reviewed step S2.1 (markDone in src/update.mjs) against its Goal/Acceptance and the shared step-line format.

All 5 locked tests pass (`node --test tests/locked/s2_1.test.mjs`: 5/5). Additional edge-case probes confirmed correct behavior: CRLF and every other byte preserved; `[x]`/`[X]` already-done steps return text unchanged; unknown id throws `unknown step` (including when another done step exists and for empty text); indented lines with the same id ignored; strict id equality (S1.10 not confused with S1.1); no-trailing-newline input handled.

Scope: only `src/update.mjs` changed (allowed: `src/update.mjs`, `src/parse.mjs`); `src/parse.mjs` exports untouched. No network, new dependencies, env/home reads, or secrets.

VERDICT: APPROVE. Minor note: `src/update.mjs:6` requires a literal space after the step id (tab => unknown step), matching `src/parse.mjs:6`, though the shared format says "whitespace" — an untested but consistent edge case, not a defect.
